# Packet — ani-001-a: Spell 1, first half

Established from Budge 1895, pp. 19–20. Start: {"page": 19, "plate": "V", "line": 1, "note": "Under the heading \"PLATE V.\" on p. 19: \"ḥā em reu nu pert em hru\" (The beginning of the chapters of coming forth by day); rows 1–3 overlined (red)."}. End: {"page": 20, "plate": "V", "line": 13, "lastWord": "Ànnu", "note": "... [on] day that of weighing of words in the dwelling of the Old Man mighty in Heliopolis. (p. 20 last row; nuk Ṭetṭeti se, \"I am Tetteti, the son of\", begins the next part)"}.

(Plate IV, the judgment scene: previous part); p. 20: footnote 1 (to àmṭu: "Or temṭu; see Brugsch, Wörterbuch (Suppl.), p. 76"); p. 20: the last three groups of the last row, nuk / Ṭetṭeti / se (the sentence ends on p. 21: next part).
